title: Stability of supermartingale optimal transport problems
abstract:
arXiv:2603.27940v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We investigate stability properties of weak supermartingale optimal transport (WSOT) problems on $\mathbb{R}$. For probability measures $\mu,
u\in\mathcal{P}_r$ satisfying $\mu \leq_{cd} 
u$ (equivalently, $\Pi_S(\mu,
u)
eq\emptyset$), we consider supermartingale couplings $\pi=\mu(d x)\pi_x(d y)$ and the weak transport functional \[ V_S^C(\mu,
u) := \inf_{\pi\in\Pi_S(\mu,
u)} \int_\mathbb{R} C(x,\pi_x)\,\mu(d x), \] for some appropriate cost function $C:\mathbb{R}	imes\mathcal{P}_r	o\mathbb{R}$. Our first main contribution is an approximation result in adapted Wasserstein distance: under $W_r$-convergence of marginals $(\mu^k,
u^k)	o(\mu,
u)$ with $\mu^k\leq_{cd} 
u^k$, any $\pi\in\Pi_S(\mu,
u)$ can be approximated by $\pi^k\in\Pi_S(\mu^k,
u^k)$ such that $A\mathcal{W}_r(\pi^k,\pi)	o0$. As a consequence, we obtain the continuity of the functional $(\mu,
u) \mapsto V_S^C(\mu,
u)$, and the monotonicity principle

translated_title: 超鞅最优传输问题的稳定性
translated_abstract:
我们研究了 $\mathbb{R}$ 上弱超鞅最优传输（WSOT）问题的稳定性。对于满足 $\mu \leq_{cd} 
u$（等价地，$\Pi_S(\mu,
u)
eq\emptyset$）的概率测度 $\mu,
u\in\mathcal{P}_r$，我们考虑超鞅耦合 $\pi=\mu(dx)\pi_x(dy)$ 以及弱传输泛函 \[ V_S^C(\mu,
u) := \inf_{\pi\in\Pi_S(\mu,
u)} \int_\mathbb{R} C(x,\pi_x)\,\mu(dx), \] 其中 $C:\mathbb{R}	imes\mathcal{P}_r	o\mathbb{R}$ 为某个适当的成本函数。我们的第一个主要贡献是关于适应性 Wasserstein 距离的逼近结果：在边缘测度 $(\mu^k,
u^k)	o(\mu,
u)$ 按 $W_r$ 收敛且 $\mu^k\leq_{cd} 
u^k$ 的条件下，任意 $\pi\in\Pi_S(\mu,
u)$ 都可以被 $\pi^k\in\Pi_S(\mu^k,
u^k)$ 逼近，使得 $A\mathcal{W}_r(\pi^k,\pi)	o0$。由此，我们得到了泛函 $(\mu,
u) \mapsto V_S^C(\mu,
u)$ 的连续性以及单调性原理。
tldr: 本文证明了弱超鞅最优传输问题的稳定性：通过在适应性Wasserstein距离下逼近超鞅耦合，建立了价值泛函的连续性及单调性原理。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the stability of weak supermartingale optimal transport problems by approximating supermartingale couplings in adapted Wasserstein distance, yielding continuity of the value functional and a monotonicity principle.
